entities.summary: Douwe Egberts is a Dutch brand specialising in coffee and related products. It is owned by JDE Peet's, a Dutch global coffee and tea company. The brand is marketed to retail consumers in Australia, Belgium, Hungary, Netherlands, New Zealand, South Africa and the United Kingdom.
